situations.headline: Diversified Energy to acquire Birch Permian Holdings for ~$759M cash

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Diversified Energy to acquire Birch Permian Holdings for ~$759M cash (interest 6, risk 3)

thesis.text: DEC is executing a sizeable ($759M cash) Permian Basin bolt-on acquisition of Birch Permian Holdings, funded via cash consideration with a $50M upfront deposit, structured with contemporaneous side-deals (MIP Interest Sale, Birch II Subsidiary Sale) that must all close together; 80%+ stockholder consent is already lined up, reducing deal-approval risk, but closing (targeted Nov 19, 2026) remains subject to customary conditions and financing/financial-statement delivery timing, making this a watch item for financing terms, leverage impact, and integration disclosures in subsequent filings.
